sloka: राघवेन अभये दत्ते सम्नतो रावण अनुजः ।विभीषणो महाप्राज्ञो भूमिम् समवलोकयत् ॥६-१९-१॥।।
transliteration: rāghavena abhaye datte samnato rāvaṇa anujaḥ ।vibhīṣaṇo mahāprājño bhūmim samavalokayat ॥6-19-1॥।।

translations.english: Having heard Hanuman (son of wind god) formidable Rama was highly pleased at heart and started to tell his opinion.
